# FishHist: Southeast Fisheries Management History Data Package

## Overview <img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" style="padding: 10px"/>

FishHist provides a method for generating an analysis-ready version of the Management History Database. 
In their original format, the records in this database represent Federal Register (FR) changes in management 
actions affecting federally managed species throughout the Gulf of America, South Atlantic, and U.S. Caribbean regions. 
The data files and code contained in this repository define and execute logic for grouping and creating streamlined 
time series of related management events.
